recognize_zh: 免疫組織化學染色中，大型腫瘤細胞呈瀰漫、強烈的細胞膜環狀陽性，勾勒出大而形狀不規則的細胞輪廓；圖上未標示抗體名稱，需搭配 CD20/PAX5 與 CD30 染色結果判讀。
features: Diffuse sheet of large tumor cells with strong membranous staining
Crisp circumferential membrane outlines with some cytoplasmic/dot-like accentuation
Large, pleomorphic unstained nuclei with vesicular chromatin in hematoxylin counterstain
Scattered larger cells with abundant cytoplasm
Nearly all neoplastic cells positive; antibody not specified in image
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain shows a diffuse population of large pleomorphic cells with strong, circumferential membranous staining and focal cytoplasmic accentuation in virtually all tumor cells. The specific antibody is not indicated on the image; the staining pattern would fit either a pan-B-cell marker such as CD20 or CD30. In the context of an anaplastic large B-cell morphology, findings support diffuse large B-cell lymphoma, anaplastic variant, and should be interpreted with the full panel.

ddx.vs: ALCL is uniformly CD30+ with membrane and Golgi staining but negative for CD20/PAX5 and positive for T-cell or cytotoxic markers.
cHL shows CD30/CD15 staining of scattered Hodgkin/Reed-Sternberg cells rather than diffuse sheets, with weak PAX5 and CD20 negativity.
PMBL has sclerosis with clear-cell morphology, often weak CD30, and CD23/MAL positivity in a mediastinal mass.
